text: The storeroom wall's intact second half (49–154) shares many phrases with the sanctum's part 3, e.g. (tree horn)(lean-low horn), (tree+loop arrow)(box-curl moon), (lean-low horn)(seed+arch moon). If the sanctum's intact old part 1 turns out to be the old version of part 3, it could restore the storeroom's scraped first half.
